title: URF-Jacobi Replication Archive — Jacobi instability on SPD(n) as a precursor of systemic financial transitions
description:
Replication archive accompanying the manuscript "Jacobi instability on SPD(n) as a precursor of systemic financial transitions" by E. Papadopoulos, submitted to Physics Letters A (2026).

The archive contains four forensic JSON snapshots covering the dot-com (2000), 2008 GFC, COVID (2020) and 2025 trade-war crises; the frozen S&P 500 daily close series (1998–2026); and a self-contained verify.py script that reproduces every numerical claim of the Letter (mean lead time 332 days; 95% bootstrap CI lower bound 290 days; Bonferroni-corrected Mann–Whitney p = 0.007 for R(t), p = 0.005 for TSS(t); Minsky-signature Test 6).

The implementation pipeline producing the geometric indicators is intentionally not included; the methodology is fully described in §2–3 of the Letter. This archive provides the machine-readable data and verification harness so that any reader can confirm the published claims from the data alone.
